title: Hard-block correctness
notes: All 2,000 cohort pairs plus the fixture's extra withdrawal cases (the cohort has no withdrawn-from-employer history, so that one code needs supplying). Expected blocks are derived MECHANICALLY from the seven rules in the design spec §5, re-implemented independently of src/lib/connect/matching-shared.ts — an agreement between the code and a copy of itself proves nothing.
